scenes.stage_direction: Calls and protected interviews interrupt the search. Amara asks practical questions about Ethan's care before she asks about blame.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: He is safe. We reached him at the yard.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Say it again. I need one person to have been reached in time.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: He saw the receiving desk. He can identify who recruited Lami.

metadata.evidence_summary: The team reaches him in time and brings him to safety.
